title: The storm that surprised everyone
subtitle: Hurricane Otis, 2023: from tropical storm to Category 5 in a day
hook: In October 2023 Hurricane Otis grew from a tropical storm into a Category 5 hurricane in about a day and struck Acapulco almost unannounced. Every forecast missed it. Predict it.
note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
